content:
Another streaming service has raised its prices. Peacock has increased the price of all three subscription plans, with a maximum monthly increase of $3 or a maximum annual increase of $30.

Following Peacock's latest price hike, the Premium Plus monthly subscription is now $20. However, the bundle discount offer with Apple appears to remain unchanged for now.

Peacock currently increases by $3 per month

The streaming platform stated: "This price adjustment enables Peacock to continue delivering the best experience to viewers, maintaining competitiveness in the market, and bringing unique content to all types of audiences."

Under Peacock's new pricing, the entry-level Select plan is now $8.99 per month or $89.99 per year, up from the previous $7.99 and $79.99 respectively.

Peacock Premium has increased from $10.99 to $12.99 per month, while the annual fee has risen from $109.99 to $129.99.

Peacock Premium Plus, the plan that is nearly ad-free and supports downloads, is now $19.99 per month or $199.99 per year, up from the previous $16.99 per month and $169.99 per year.

Across the lineup, Peacock Premium saw the largest percentage increase at approximately 18%. The annual plan equates to paying for about 10 months at the new monthly price, excluding any limited-time offers.

The new pricing takes effect today (August 18) and applies to new and resubscribing users.

Existing subscribers will pay the new price starting from their first billing date on or after September 17. Current annual plans and ongoing promotional offers will maintain their original pricing until expiration.

Two years ago, Premium monthly fee was adjusted to $7.99, while Premium Plus was $13.99. Peacock subsequently launched Select, while continuing to raise prices on its two main plans. Premium alone has seen an additional $5 monthly increase in just over two years.

Apple TV bundle offer appears unchanged for now

One unanswered question concerns the bundle offer between Apple TV and Peacock.

Apple still lists Apple TV with Peacock Premium at $14.99 per month, and with Premium Plus at $19.99 per month. As we mentioned in April, compared to Apple TV's standalone subscription of $12.99 per month, this means Peacock effectively costs just $2 or $7 extra.

Currently, Apple's bundle offer page still shows both prices remaining unchanged.

That said, subscribers continue to face a series of price hikes across various entertainment services. Apple also joined the price increase wave last month, raising prices for Apple Music and Apple One.
